findings.classification: required fixture experiment not established; product failure not proved
findings.facts: First held startup and URL keyboard/health checks passed. Second held loop timed out without recording early state. Server trace shows first shell request, then cached navigations with sample responses in one second and no second shell request.
findings.inference: Caching/interception is a stronger lead than cold graph cost, but source logs alone cannot prove whether Fetch.requestPaused was missing or shell exported too early.
findings.minimumNextStep: Scope Network.setCacheDisabled(true) to the Fetch-held experiment, restore afterwards; record request_id, bootOrder, target/current URL, navigationStale, CLLoadStage/CLLoadError and health on failure. Require fresh document and graph-ready-before-shell; keep bounded deadline, no skip. root alone repeats --only loader after full suite.
